title: Unused `g` in test_stats_replay_identity — Odin 'declared but not used' compile error breaks `odin test core`
evidence:
r, g, h := test_seed_fixture(&replay, &cat)
	for i in 0..<20 {
		flow_seed_demand(&replay.flow, u64(1+i*2), r, h, 0)
		flow_seed_demand(&replay.flow, u64(2+i*2), h, r, 1)
	}
...
	_ = man // the manifest was the replay precondition; its hashes pin the state
detail: `g` is never used after declaration. Odin rejects unused locals (the `_ = man` dodge in this same diff proves the codebase hits that error), so the test package fails to compile, contradicting '165 tests green'.

title: Spec claims per-frame stats compute in the app; the code computes only per stepped tick
location: _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-5-7-runtime-telemetry.md: Code Map / Design Notes vs app/main.odin
detail: The app computes the record inside the fixed-timestep catch-up loop only; there is no per-frame compute. Behavior matches the per-stepped-tick emission rule, so the spec text is stale/wrong.
recommended_fix: Update the spec wording to 'per stepped tick; the overlay reads the latest record each frame'.

title: Bundle members double-draw the heat tint and util% label — identical endpoints, one row per member
detail: Parallel bundle members share the same node pair, so each congested bundle strokes the same segment and draws the same midpoint label once per member — double alpha blend and overdrawn labels.
recommended_fix: Dedupe per bundle: emit the tint/label once per bundle (first live member) instead of once per member row.

title: AC2's app-stream replay-identity claim has no automated verification — the app path is only compiled
evidence:
- Given `app --stats-out <path>` on a fresh launch (seed 42 + the hardcoded fixture), when the run steps, then the stream matches the harness's format and is replay-identical for the same seed+commands — AC2.
...
- `odin build app` + `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true` — both compile.
detail: No test byte-compares an app-written stream against the harness stream; verification only compiles the app. The app's driver-side emission (event-slice hashing, restart append) is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a headless pin of the app's per-step emission, or explicitly mark AC2 as manually verified.
